description.value: Taki's Taverna is a Greek restaurant situated on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End neighbourhood. It offers indoor seating in a no-smoking environment and is noted as wheelchair accessible per OSM. Its location in a dense, bikeable urban corridor makes it a potential stop for cyclists exploring downtown Vancouver.
